notes.title: There is information that causes an error in Steam Deck.
notes.content:
There is information that causes an error in Steam Deck.
There have been reports of errors when compositing.
They say it happens on Steam Deck, but not on laptop windows, which seems to be an OS problem.
It is currently not recommended for use on Steam Deck.
I hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Tutorial fixes and implementation of autosave to save16 and other updates
notes.content:
Tutorial fixes and implementation of autosave to save16 and other updates
Note that save 16 is automatically overwritten during sleep.

・When a field is released, an image guidance is added.
・Adjusted line break cursor design for text.
・Fade-in and fade-out expressions have been adjusted.
・A confirmation dialog box is now displayed when the Close button is pressed.
・Auto-save to save 16 function implemented.
・Improved winter graphics

notes.content:
Game balance was adjusted and minor bugs and design tweaks were made.

・Decreased energy consumption on sunny days.
・BGM window design has been unified.

・Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.content: Fixed some bugs and changed fonts

notes.title: Adjust the game balance of crops, and indicate the selling price.
notes.content:
We have updated the game with some suggestions from those of you who have played the game.
Adjust the game balance of crops, and indicate the selling price.

* Adjusted the purchase price of crop seeds to half the price.
* Adjusted the selling price of food to half of its original price
* Selling prices are now displayed for items that can be sold.

notes.title: Adjusted game balance and improved text visibility
notes.content:
We have updated the game with some suggestions from those of you who have played the game.

・Fixed the position of line breaks in English.
・Changed the weight that can be possessed at game startup from 30 to 35.
・Reduced activity consumption on rainy days.
・Fixed Chinese font.

notes.title: Fixed Load BGM Error
notes.content:
Fixed Load BGM Error.
Fixed an error that prevented background music from loading.
The game will be fixed in the update. Alternatively, please restart the game in a field where the music can be loaded.
If you still get the error, we are really sorry, but please start a new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281448/cf9cfa86a75d7d0eebe161711d0d6c3443746a06.png[/img]
